item.title: One year later, Los Angeles residents continue to face rebuilding challenges: 'Fatigue factor'
item.description: LA City Council waives permit fees for Palisades and Eaton fire victims, removing financial barriers to help residents rebuild their homes faster.

item.title: Thousands of US flights canceled as Northeast braces for blizzard
item.description: A Northeast blizzard has forced airlines to cancel more than 8,800 flights and delay thousands more as parts of the region brace for 1 to more than 2 feet of snow.

item.title: TANVI RATNA: India, AI and America’s new 'Global South' strategy
item.description: Major AI summit in India reveals U.S. strategy to lead Global South technology adoption through $250 billion deals and new supply chain partnerships.

item.title: Chicago office market in freefall amid national downturn
item.description: Office buildings across major U.S. cities are selling at shocking 70-90% discounts as remote work continues to reshape commercial real estate markets nationwide.

item.title: Judge struggles to seat jury in Elon Musk investor trial amid ‘hate’ for tech billionaire: report
item.description: Jury selection for Elon Musk's investor trial proves challenging as prospective jurors reportedly express strong negative views about the billionaire entrepreneur.

item.title: ‘We were right’: He took Trump’s tariffs to the Supreme Court and won
item.description: Wine importer Victor Schwartz challenged Trump's tariffs at the Supreme Court and won, dealing a blow to the trade agenda after survival threats.

item.title: Salads outsell fried favorites at this California chicken chain growing nationwide
item.description: California chicken chain Starbird reports salads now outsell fried chicken as top menu category ahead of five-state expansion into Washington and beyond.

item.title: Grubhub, DoorDash shut down NYC operations as city enforces travel ban during 'historic' blizzard
item.description: Major delivery platforms including DoorDash and Grubhub are halting their New York City operations as a historic blizzard threatens to bring two feet of snow.

item.title: Metal fragments found in frozen meatballs sold at Aldi stores nationwide prompts recall
item.description: FSIS announces recall of nearly 9,500 pounds of frozen meatballs due to potential metal contamination. Consumer reported finding metal pieces in the product.

item.title: US, Canadian airlines cancel Puerto Vallarta flights after reported killing of cartel leader ‘El Mencho’
item.description: Airlines canceled flights to parts of Mexico after the drug lord "El Mencho" was reportedly killed by the Mexican government, leading to violent clashes.
